jobs.name: THD HRM Token Auto-Refresh
jobs.prompt:
Refresh the THD HRM session token. Run this exact command via terminal:

curl -sk -c /tmp/hrm_cookies.txt -b /tmp/hrm_cookies.txt \
  -D /tmp/hrm_refresh_headers.txt -o /tmp/hrm_refresh_resp.json \
  -w "REFRESH_RESULT:%{http_code}" \
  -X POST "https://hrm.thdcybersecurity.com/checkinapi/auth/refresh" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" \
  -H "Origin: https://hrm.thdcybersecurity.com" \
  -H "Referer: https://hrm.thdcybersecurity.com/login"

Then read /tmp/hrm_refresh_resp.json and /tmp/hrm_cookies.txt to verify. If refresh fails (HTTP non-2xx), re-login:
1. POST /checkinapi/auth/login with {"email":"trien.l@thdcybersecurity.xyz","password":"Levantrien25@"}
2. If requiresTotp=true, generate TOTP from secret "BIQGYLIREMUDGXAZCJAXUVSTE5NBCTYF" using Python hmac/base64/struct
3. POST /checkinapi/auth/2fa/login with totpToken and the generated code
4. Save cookies to /tmp/hrm_cookies.txt

Report the HTTP status and whether tokens were refreshed successfully.
